summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 2 testing of Travel & Fleet Management ERP. All backend APIs (52/52 tests) and frontend pages tested successfully. RBAC verified for all roles.
passed_tests: Backend: Auth login for all roles (owner, ops_admin, driver)
Backend: Vehicles CRUD - GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE working, duplicate plate_number rejected (400), delete blocked with bookings (400)
Backend: Drivers CRUD - GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE working, delete blocked with active bookings (400)
Backend: Customers CRUD - GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE working, delete blocked with bookings (400)
Backend: Customer 360 - GET /customers/{id} returns bookings array + stats (bookings_count, total_spent, active_bookings)
Backend: Bookings CRUD - GET/POST/PATCH working, transitions (confirm/cancel/complete) working
Backend: INV-1 verified - booking.total_amount = base_price + sum(add_ons)
Backend: INV-2 verified - booking.paid_amount = sum(payments), overpayment rejected (400)
Backend: INV-3 verified - payment_status derivation (belum_bayar -> dp -> lunas -> selesai)
Backend: INV-4 verified - anti double-booking (overlapping dates rejected with 400)
Backend: INV-9 verified - dashboard active_bookings count matches confirmed/ongoing bookings, vehicles count correct
Backend: Payments - POST /payments working, DP and full payment flow working, overpayment rejected
Backend: Dashboard - GET /dashboard returns all required fields, role-aware (owner gets revenue_month, outstanding_ar)
Backend: RBAC - driver denied (403) on POST/PATCH/DELETE vehicles/drivers and GET customers/payments
Backend: RBAC - ops_admin has full access to vehicles/drivers/customers/payments
Backend: RBAC - owner has full access to all endpoints
Backend: FK guards - delete vehicle/customer with bookings blocked (400)
Frontend: Login page loads and redirects to dashboard after successful login
Frontend: Dashboard page loads with KPI cards (8 cards), reminders section, recent bookings section, entity bar chart
Frontend: Vehicles page loads with table, reminders banner (3 documents due), 'Tambah Armada' button
Frontend: Drivers page loads with table, 'Tambah Driver' button
Frontend: Customers page loads with table, 'Tambah Customer' button
Frontend: Customer 360 dialog opens on row click, shows customer stats and booking history
Frontend: Bookings page loads with table, 'Buat Booking' button, payment buttons (2), edit buttons (3), complete/cancel buttons (3 each)
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: 'Tambah Armada' button hidden on Vehicles page
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: Edit/Delete buttons hidden on Vehicles page
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: 'Tambah Driver' button hidden on Drivers page
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: Edit/Delete buttons hidden on Drivers page
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: Customers link hidden from sidebar
Frontend: RBAC - driver role: Can view Vehicles and Drivers pages (read-only)
Frontend: All pages render correctly with proper data loading
